Notes: System-wide manual / automatic selector. FB4 writes it to HMI.Controls.Mode on every valve. Start value TRUE, so the pod restarts in manual.
Starts FB8. Blocked while ManualMode is set or the reconnect sequence is active. OB1 resets it once FB8 reports S_ACTIVE.
Starts FB9. Blocked while ManualMode is set; its guard against the disconnect sequence is not yet correct (PLC OI-16). OB1 resets it once FB9 reports S_ACTIVE.
Set while FB8 or FB9 is active. The element sequencers are not called while it is set, so element requests are ignored.
Vent-confirmed pressure threshold. Used by every Cmd_Gate instance and by FB8. Returns to its start value on PLC restart.
Unlock-confirmed pressure threshold. Used by every Cmd_Gate instance and by FB8.
Lock-confirmed pressure threshold. Used by every Cmd_Gate instance and by FB9.
Pressure hold tolerance. Used by every Cmd_Gate instance.
Drives Lockout on all 35 Valve-SV instances and OFF_SQ on both stack sequences. Non-retain: a PLC restart clears an active E-stop.
Drives Estop on Pumps, it turns them off.
0 none, 1 lock, 2 unlock. Acted on by T3 and T7 only with the matching permissive; otherwise ignored. Not cleared by the PLC - the HMI clears it once the element leaves idle.
Drives AckReset: clears a fault and returns the sequence to step 1. Not cleared by the PLC.
0 unknown, 1 locked, 2 unlocked, 3 locking, 4 unlocking, 5 fault. Use 5 as the fault indicator. Written as 1 at power-up without pressure confirmation.
Step that failed: 3, 4, 7 or 8. Not cleared on reset, so it records the last fault rather than a current one.
0 manual, 1 automatic. Written every scan by FB4 from DB84.ManualMode, so it is read-only from the HMI.
HMI Notes: Not accessible on SafeStack through its faceplate; this mode is system wide through ManualMode.

Notes: 0 stop, 1 close, 2 open. Acted on in manual mode only. Returns to 0 on PLC restart.
Mirrors the Lockout input, driven by DB84.Estop.Valves.
HMI Notes: Not accessible or visible in SafeStack HMI. Value is used for Estop Valve.

Notes: Permissive input not satisfied. Driven from Cmd_Gate.
HMI Notes: Not accessible or visible in SafeStack HMI.

Notes: Block output. The value every sequence transition compares against, and the reading to display. In engineering units once commissioning sets the range - see PLC OI-01.
Packed alarm word, bits 0 to 9 (PLC handover 6.5).
Engineering scale maximum. FB default until commissioning sets the transmitter range - see PLC OI-01.
Engineering scale minimum. Set at commissioning with EngMax.
Substitution enable.
Substitute value used while substitution is enabled.
HHH, HH, H, L, LL, LLL alarm limits, plus OR and UR.
